title: Keep one-sheet evidence preliminary
description: Encode evidence-language rules that keep one-sheet results preliminary and reserve placement-variation, suitability, and higher-confidence language for policy-defined repeated physical samples; the current unresolved policy must refuse those claims.
acceptanceCriteria: One physical sample can never produce validated suitability, variation, or higher-confidence language
Demo, synthetic, or PDF-structure samples produce no physical evidence language
Repeated-sample language requires an explicit approved policy version and its defined qualifying sample count
With current blockers unresolved, all validated or suitability language requests are refused

steps.details: Model software-only, demo, preliminary physical observation, and policy-authorized repeated-evidence language without inventing numeric thresholds.
Select only language permitted by provenance, approved policy, and qualifying sample status; default to blocked or preliminary wording.
Reject suitability, variation, confidence, guarantee, and validation wording when policy or repeated samples are absent.
Cover zero, demo, synthetic, one physical, mixed, and unresolved repeated-sample fixtures with exact allowed/refused language classes.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement conservative language classification and fixtures only.
BLOCKED: policy-authorized repeated-evidence language cannot be completed or enabled until physical policy and qualifying observations exist.
Placement bias and placement variation are distinct and must not be conflated.
